findings.current: A few days ago, when stupid Taishan couldn’t save Lord, Pavilion Master did.
findings.defect: The source says the Pavilion Master saved Lord in Taishan’s place; it does not say Taishan was unable to save him. The current wording turns the contrast in who saved Lord into an explicit inability.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 멍청한 태산이 대신 주군을 구했던 건 바로 각주였으니까: it was the Pavilion Master who saved Lord instead of stupid Taishan.
findings.replacement: A few days ago, it was Pavilion Master who saved Lord instead of stupid Taishan.

summary: The assembled chapter is faithful overall. One line adds an unsupported implication about Taishan’s ability to save Lord.
